criteria.description: Evaluation per criterion, according to the laboratory rubric.

criterion_id.description: Criterion ID as defined in rubric.json.

justification.description: Short criterion-level rationale in Portuguese, balancing positive evidence and deductions.

success_evidence.description: Concrete positive evidence of learning or implemented behavior, in Portuguese.

evidence_refs.description: References to files, methods, tests, or line ranges that support the score.

non_penalized_observations.description: Real observations that should not reduce the score, in Portuguese.

deductions.description: Restricted list of major material failures explaining the discount.

confidence.description: Confidence that this is a real penalizable issue.

rubric_anchor.description: Short reference to the rubric requirement this deduction affects.

problem.description: Concrete description of the problem, in Portuguese.

consequence.description: Structural, functional, or pedagogical impact, in Portuguese.

how_to_fix.description: How to resolve this defect within the lab scope, in Portuguese.

evidence_refs.description: Corresponding code locations, methods, attributes, or tests.

requires_human_review.description: True when ambiguous evidence or low-confidence deductions need human review.

grading_basis.description: Brief note in Portuguese explaining whether grading relied on static reading, tests, build output, or other evidence.

main_uncertainties.description: Uncertainties a human reviewer should inspect.

potential_false_positive_risks.description: Places where an apparent issue may have an equivalent implementation elsewhere.
